description: This file contains action creators and utility functions for handling app interactions within the Mattermost web application, including binding click handling, form fetching, app call execution, modal opening, and ephemeral post responses.

methods.name: handleBindingClick
methods.description: Handles click events on app bindings, fetching forms or submitting data as needed.

methods.name: doAppSubmit
methods.description: Executes an app call with submit tracking, handling different response types including form, navigate, and errors.

methods.name: doAppFetchForm
methods.description: Fetches a form from the app call response, handling errors and response types.

methods.name: doAppLookup
methods.description: Performs an app call to retrieve data, handling response types.

methods.name: makeFetchBindings
methods.description: Creates a function to fetch app bindings for a specific location, filtering by channel and team.

methods.name: openAppsModal
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog with an app form.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForPost
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post response associated with a specific post.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForChannel
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post response to a specific channel.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForContext
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post response within a specific app context.

methods.name: postEphemeralCallResponseForCommandArgs
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post response using command arguments.
